name: wedding-invite
description: Personalized wedding invitation site: React + styled-components SPA with an Express API backed by Google Sheets, deployed on Cloud Run via Cloud Build.

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && vitest run
